walkthrough.short: Right hand to the one facing you, pull by; left to the next; right to the one after.
walkthrough.long: Give your right hand to the dancer facing you along the line and pull by; give your left to the next one and pull by; right hand to the one after that. Keep going the way you started — three hands, two beats each — and let the line run past you.

call.long: GRAND RIGHT AND LEFT THREE HANDS
